To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
ABA-responsive ABRE-Binding Factor3 (Ppy ABF3) activates Dormancy-associated Mads-box (DAM)3 expression to promote the endo-dornancy in pear (P. pyrifolia).
PpyABF and PpyDAMSVP are involved in the control of bud dormancy in pear.
ABA induces DAM expression through the activation of ABF3.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of DAM gene expression by PpyABFs and provides new insights into AABA-related bud dormancy.
the finely regulated regulation mechanism of ABA on the expression of DAM genes and provides new insight into ABA-related dormancy regulation.
the regulatory mechanism underlying the role of the ABA-responsive transcription factor ABF3 in the activation of PpyDAM expression, which contributes to the regulation of bud endo-dormant status.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the finely tuned regulatory mechanisms underlying the effect of abscisic acid on DAM gene expression are revealed and new insights into AABA-related bud dormancy regulations are provided.
the ABA-responsive PpyABF proteins regulate the expression of PpyDAM genes by binding directly to the ABREs in their promoters to promote bud dormacy in pear.
ABA regulates bud dormancy through the activation of DAM genes by ABF3, which is consistent with the results of previous studies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ABA signalling cascade regulates the expression of DAM3 in pear buds to promote endo-dormant transition and that PpyABF1, PpyABFs, PpyABRE and PpyDREB1A play key roles in this regulation.

ABA-responsive ABRE-Binding Factor3 regulates DAM3 expression to control bud dormancy in pear, and the mechanism is tightly controlled by another ABA-responsive ABF protein, ABF2, which interacts with ABF3 to repress its activation of DAM3 expression.

we identified a new ABA signalling factor PpyABF, which is a key regulator in the ABA signalling to control DAM gene expression, and the ABA-PpyABF3-DAM signalling pathway is involved in the bud dormancy maintenance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ABA-responsive ABRE-Binding Factor3 activates DAM3 to promote endo-dormant bud formation.
we identified a novel mechanism of ABA-mediated bud dormancy regulation by revealing the direct regulation of ABA-responsive ABF on DAM gene expression in pear.

we identified the ABA-responsive ABRE-binding factor3 (ABF3) as a key regulator of dormancy-associated MADS box (DAM) gene expression, and that ABF3 directly bound the second ABRE element in the PpyABF promoter and activated its expression.
